content.thinking: I'll check for duplicates based on vendor, amount, date, and the invoice number's middle portion, since the embedded invoice ID makes a strict check too weak. I'll also review payment-to-journal ties and compare the period against invoice dates.

input.sql: select a."INV_ID" a_id, b."INV_ID" b_id, a."VEND_CD", a."INV_NO" an, b."INV_NO" bn, a."INV_AMT", a."INV_DT", b."INV_DT", a."JRNL_NO", b."JRNL_NO" from "APINVH" a join "APINVH" b on a."INV_ID"<b."INV_ID" and trim(a."VEND_CD")=trim(b."VEND_CD") and a."INV_AMT"=b."INV_AMT" order by 1 limit 30

select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", p."PAY_DT", i."INV_AMT", h."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", h."MEMO", (select sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") dr from "APPAYM" p join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" left join "GLJRNH" h on h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" where h."JRNL_NO" is null or (select sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO")<>p."PAY_AMT" or h."MEMO"<>'Payment '||i."INV_NO" limit 30

select i."INV_ID", i."INV_DT", i."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT" from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where i."INV_DT" not between p."STRT_DT" and p."END_DT" limit 30
